limitations: Full text of arXiv:2609.19493 could not be retrieved through direct arXiv or open-access mirrors, and the institutional retrieval service was unavailable; the audited proof therefore reconstructs the alphabet transfer from the package rather than relying on an unread source proof.; The closest primary binary preprint was not available in full text during this run, so a differently phrased remark in that manuscript remains a residual priority risk; no available evidence supplied broader uniform-q coverage.

record_title: The 2t-1 deletion-code redundancy coefficient extends to q-ary alphabets
